summary: Per spatial cell, contract the molecular three-family assembled SIG collision matrices (CX, H2-H, H2-H+) with the Fortran-order flattened predecessor distributions to three (nvr,nvx,nx) Alpha collision-frequency fields; ni_correct selects the source's max(n - nHP, 0) ion-density correction.

identity.relation: Alpha_CX[:,:,k] = F^-1(SIG_CX @ F(fHp_hat[:,:,k]*nHP[k])), Alpha_H2_H[:,:,k] = F^-1(SIG_H2_H @ F(fH[:,:,k])), Alpha_H2_P[:,:,k] = F^-1(SIG_H2_P @ F(fi_hat[:,:,k]*ni[k])), with ni = n, or ni = max(n - nHP, 0) when ni_correct is set; F/F^-1 are the source's legacy Fortran-order (order='F') flatten/restore between the (nvr,nvx) slice and the (nvr*nvx,) Work carrier.
identity.direction: three assembled SIG collision matrices + explicit predecessor distributions and densities (fH, fHp_hat, fi_hat, n, nHP) -> three Alpha collision-frequency fields (Alpha_CX, Alpha_H2_H, Alpha_H2_P)
identity.definition: The saved source's per-k matrix-vector contraction: each family multiplies one assembled (N,N) SIG matrix by the Fortran-order flattening of one predecessor distribution carried on the (nvr*nvx,) Work buffer and restores the product to the (nvr,nvx) slice. The CX family carries fHp_hat (the H2+ Maxwellian seeded with drift vxi and temperature THP) scaled cell-wise by nHP[k]; the H2-H family carries the bare atomic distribution fH; the H2-P family carries the proton seed fi_hat scaled by ni, where ni = n or, when ni_correct is set, ni = max(n - nHP, 0) cell-wise.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, which reproduces the intended Fortran-order contraction with the minimal reshape repair of the registered kinetic_h2.py:1204 Alpha_CX defect; reproduced bit for bit on the declared legal domain (SHA-256-pinned environment-gated replay)
identity.geometry: per spatial cell k: an (nvr,nvx) cylindrical velocity slice Fortran-order flattened to an (N,) carrier (N = nvr*nvx), contracted against an (N,N) assembled collision matrix, restored to (nvr,nvx); iterated over nx slices
identity.coordinates: cylindrical (vr,vx) velocity space per spatial slice x; velocity axes in the caller's normalized units, densities in m^-3; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion
identity.boundary: finite aligned inputs of the declared shapes; negative or zero densities are not rejected at runtime -- every finite density profile is contracted as given (the ni_correct branch clamps n - nHP at zero cell-wise, which is a source-defined density correction, not a positivity gate); bounded negative output cells inherited from the signed elastic SIG families (vx_vx factors) are reproduced as-is, never clamped
assumptions: Registered source defect, repaired in the saved formal implementation: kinetic_h2.py:1204 writes Alpha_CX[:,:,k] = SIG_CX @ Work without the Fortran-order restore reshape, which fails on the canonical nvr*nvx carrier. The saved formal implementation applies the minimal .reshape(..., order='F') repair; this port reproduces the repaired saved implementation bit for bit, and the original defect stays registered verbatim in the immutable source for expert review.

The SIG matrices arrive already assembled (molecular three-family collision-matrix assembly): entries are cross section times relative speed times the velocity-space quadrature weight evaluated on the (vr,vx) energy carrier, including the signed elastic vx_vx factors; this operator only contracts and never clamps or re-scales them.
Bounded negative cells inherited from the signed elastic SIG families are reproduced as-is; whether they correspond to physically acceptable diffusion behavior is left to expert review.
Negative or zero densities are not rejected at runtime; the saved domain assumes physically meaningful finite profiles, and the fail-closed contract covers only shape/alignment and non-finite values.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: SIG_CX
inputs.description: Assembled H2 + H2+ charge-exchange collision matrix from the molecular three-family assembly: sigma_cx_hh evaluated on the velocity-carrier energy grid, multiplied by the relative speed and the (Vr2pidVr*dVx) quadrature weight, laid out on the Fortran-order flattened (nvr*nvx) velocity carrier.
inputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure (cross section x relative speed x velocity-space weight); no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite; must be 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx. The saved assembly produces a nonnegative SIG_CX; the contraction preserves whatever sign pattern the caller supplies.

inputs.name: SIG_H2_H
inputs.description: Assembled H2-H elastic collision matrix: sigma_el_h_hh with weight Vr2pidVr*dVx times the signed vx_vx factor, on the same Fortran-order velocity carrier.
inputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure (cross section x relative speed x velocity-space weight); no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite; 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx. Contains bounded negative cells from the signed vx_vx factor; reproduced as-is.

inputs.name: SIG_H2_P
inputs.description: Assembled H2-H+ elastic collision matrix: sigma_el_p_h (two energy branches) with weight Vr2pidVr*dVx times the signed vx_vx factor, on the same Fortran-order velocity carrier.
inputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure (cross section x relative speed x velocity-space weight); no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite; 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx. Contains bounded negative cells from the signed vx_vx factor; reproduced as-is.

inputs.name: fH
inputs.description: Atomic neutral velocity distribution on the cylindrical (vr,vx) mesh, the predecessor carried unchanged into the Alpha_H2_H contraction.
inputs.constraints: Finite; shape (nvr,nvx,nx) exactly; its leading axes define N = nvr*nvx for every SIG matrix.

inputs.name: fHp_hat
inputs.description: H2+ molecular-ion Maxwellian seed distribution on the cylindrical (vr,vx) mesh (drift vxi, temperature THP); scaled cell-wise by nHP[k] inside the Alpha_CX contraction.

inputs.name: fi_hat
inputs.description: H+ proton Maxwellian seed distribution on the cylindrical (vr,vx) mesh (drift vxi, temperature Ti); scaled cell-wise by ni[k] inside the Alpha_H2_P contraction.

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: Electron density profile (source mesh.ne), used as the ion density ni in the Alpha_H2_P contraction unless ni_correct is set.
inputs.constraints: Finite; 1-D with size nx. Negative or zero entries are not rejected at runtime: the contraction uses each value as given.

inputs.name: nHP
inputs.description: H2+ molecular-ion density profile scaling the fHp_hat carrier in the Alpha_CX contraction and entering the ni_correct density correction.
inputs.constraints: Finite; 1-D with size nx. Negative or zero entries are not rejected at runtime.

inputs.name: ni_correct
inputs.description: Branch selector for the source's ion-density correction: when set, ni = max(n - nHP, 0) instead of ni = n (kinetic_h2.py:1221-1223).
inputs.constraints: Truthiness selects the corrected-density branch; both branches are exercised by the maintained tests.

outputs.name: Alpha_CX
outputs.description: H2 + H2+ charge-exchange collision-frequency field: SIG_CX contracted with the Fortran-order flattened (fHp_hat*nHP) carrier, one (nvr,nvx) slice per spatial cell.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled SIG measure; no implicit conversion)
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); nonnegative on the saved domain where SIG_CX is nonnegative; never clamped.

outputs.name: Alpha_H2_H
outputs.description: H2-H elastic collision-frequency field: SIG_H2_H contracted with the Fortran-order flattened fH slice.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled SIG measure; no implicit conversion)
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); bounded negative cells inherited from the signed vx_vx SIG factor are reproduced as-is, never clamped.

outputs.name: Alpha_H2_P
outputs.description: H2-H+ elastic collision-frequency field: SIG_H2_P contracted with the Fortran-order flattened (fi_hat*ni) carrier, ni = n or max(n - nHP, 0) per the ni_correct branch.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled SIG measure; no implicit conversion)
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); bounded negative cells inherited from the signed vx_vx SIG factor are reproduced as-is, never clamped.

preconditions: Finite aligned SIG matrices of common order nvr*nvx, finite (nvr,nvx,nx) distributions, and finite 1-D density profiles of size nx.
The predecessor distributions and the assembled SIG matrices already exist; this operator performs no assembly, gating, or cache handling.
supported: Molecular three-family Alpha collision-frequency contraction (Alpha_CX, Alpha_H2_H, Alpha_H2_P) on a declared velocity carrier, with both ni_correct branches.
excluded: Atomic four-family contraction, the Omega_* downstream aggregation inside fH2_iterate, Do_Alpha_* gating, KH2.Internal cache lifecycle, and external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when a SIG matrix is not 2-D square, when any SIG order differs from the nvr*nvx carrier, when any distribution is not (nvr,nvx,nx), when n or nHP is not 1-D of size nx, or when any input contains a non-finite value.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if any contracted family produces a non-finite array; no partial results are returned.

python.signature: contract_molecular_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies(SIG_CX, SIG_H2_H, SIG_H2_P, fH, fHp_hat, fi_hat, n, nHP, ni_correct=False)

example.description: With identity SIG matrices each Alpha family equals its carrier scaled by the matching density, and the ni_correct branch shifts the Alpha_H2_P carrier to max(n - nHP, 0).
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import contract_molecular_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies
nvr, nvx, nx = 2, 3, 2
N = nvr * nvx
fH = np.ones((nvr, nvx, nx))
fHp_hat = np.ones((nvr, nvx, nx))
fi_hat = np.ones((nvr, nvx, nx))
n = np.full(nx, 1e18)
nHP = np.full(nx, 4e17)
result = contract_molecular_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies(
    np.eye(N), np.eye(N), np.eye(N), fH, fHp_hat, fi_hat, n, nHP,
)
assert set(result) == {"Alpha_CX", "Alpha_H2_H", "Alpha_H2_P"}
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["Alpha_CX"], fHp_hat * 4e17)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(result["Alpha_H2_P"], fi_hat * 1e18)
corrected = contract_molecular_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies(
    np.eye(N), np.eye(N), np.eye(N), fH, fHp_hat, fi_hat, n, nHP, ni_correct=True,
)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(corrected["Alpha_H2_P"], fi_hat * 6e17)
example.expected: Alpha_CX carries fHp_hat scaled by nHP, Alpha_H2_P carries fi_hat scaled by n, and the ni_correct branch rescales it to fi_hat scaled by max(n - nHP, 0).
